verdict.rationale: Attio's docs state its data model lets you define custom objects with a wide array of attribute types, beyond the default people and companies and the optional deal object. The API lists both system-defined and user-defined objects, so developers can work with custom objects programmatically, and marketing pages describe linking objects through a graph model. missing for 10: detailed first-party docs on relationship attribute types between custom objects, documented API steps for creating custom objects and attributes, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can model custom objects with fields and relationships beyond the built-in contacts, companies, and deals

citations.quote: At the core of Attio is our powerful and flexible data model, which allows you to define custom objects and lists with a wide array of attribute types.
Create the exact data model your business needs with custom objects.
Link objects to make your data actionable and insightful with our powerful graph model.
Customize fields to capture exactly what you need to track.
Lists all system-defined and user-defined objects in your workspace
